<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <link rel="stylesheet" href="../css/style.css">
    <title>Система комментирования на JS + Typescript</title>
</head>
<body>
    <header class="header"></header>
    <div class="content-wrapper">
        <nav class="nav"></nav>
        <main class="main">
            <div class="content">
                <div class="section-line one">
                    <section class="section-small"></section>
                    <section class="section-small"></section>
                </div>
                <div class="section-line two">
                    <section class="section-small"></section>
                    <section class="section-small"></section>
                </div>
                <div class="section-line three">
                    <section class="section-small"></section>
                    <section class="section-small"></section>
                </div>
                <div class="section-line four">
                    <section class="section-small"></section>
                    <section class="section-small"></section>
                </div>
                <div class="section-line five">
                    <section class="section-big"></section>
                </div>
            </div>
            <hr class="line">
            <div class="comment-container">
                <div class="settings-buttons">
                    <div class="button-comment-container">
                        <div class="button-comment__string">
                            <a class="link-comment button-comment" href="#">Комментарии</a>
                            <p class="link-comment" id="count-comments">(0)</p>
                        </div>
                        <hr class="line-comments">
                    </div>
                    <form class="sort-button-container">
                        <select class="link-filter sort-button" id="sort-menu" name="sort">
                            <option value="by-date">По дате</option>
                            <option value="by-count-rating">По количеству оценок</option>
                            <option value="by-relevance">По актуальности</option>
                            <option value="by-number-responses">По количеству ответов</option>
                        </select>
                    </form>
                    <!--<div class="sort-button-container">
                         <a class="link-filter sort-button" href="#">По количеству оценок</a> 
                        <div class="arrow"></div>
                    </div>-->
                    <div class="favorites-button-container">
                        <a class="link-filter favorites-button" href="#">Избранное</a>
                        <div class="favorites-icon">
                            <svg width="21" height="21" viewBox="0 0 21 21" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
                                <g opacity="0.4">
                                <mask id="mask0_12_552" style="mask-type:alpha" maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x="2" y="2" width="17" height="17">
                                <rect x="2.625" y="2.625" width="15.75" height="15.75" fill="url(#pattern0_12_552)"/>
                                </mask>
                                <g mask="url(#mask0_12_552)">
                                <rect x="1.80469" y="2.625" width="19.3594" height="18.0469" fill="black"/>
                                </g>
                                </g>
                                <circle opacity="0.4" cx="10.5" cy="10.5" r="9.5" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
                                <defs>
                                <pattern id="pattern0_12_552" patternContentUnits="objectBoundingBox" width="1" height="1">
                                <use xlink:href="#image0_12_552" transform="scale(0.0104167)"/>
                                </pattern>
                                <image id="image0_12_552" width="96" height="96" preserveAspectRatio="none" xlink:href="data:image/png;base64,"/>
                                </defs>
                            </svg>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="input-comments-container" id="more-320px">
                    <div class="img-name">
                        <img class="avatar" id="my-avatar" src="../images/KorbenDetka.png" width="61" height="61">
                        <h3 id = "my-name" class="name-commentator">Илья Васильевич</h3>
                    </div>
                    <h5 class="restrictions">Макс. 1000 символов</h5>
                    <div class="textarea-wrapper">
                        <textarea id="input-comments" rows="1" placeholder="Введите текст сообщения..."></textarea>
                    </div>
                    <div class="button-container">
                        <h5 class="limit-count">Слишком длинное сообщение</h5>
                        <button class="send-comments" disabled>Отправить</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div class="input-comments-container" id="more-1300px">
                    <img class="avatar" id="my-avatar" src="../images/KorbenDetka.png" width="61" height="61">
                    <div class="input-container">
                        <div class="input-information-container">
                            <h3 id = "my-name" class="name-commentator">Илья Васильевич</h3>
                            <h5 class="restrictions">Макс. 1000 символов</h5>
                        </div>
                        <div class="textarea-wrapper">
                            <textarea id="input-comments" rows="1" placeholder="Введите текст сообщения..."></textarea>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="button-container">
                        <h5 class="limit-count">Слишком длинное сообщение</h5>
                        <button class="send-comments" disabled>Отправить</button>
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div id="comments">
                    <div class="comment-block" data-comment-id="001">
                        <img class="avatar" src="../images/Karapiteck.png" width="61" height="61">
                        <div class="input-container">
                            <div class="comment-information-container">
                                <h3 class="name-commentator">Сергей Карапитек</h3>
                                <h5 class="comment-date-time">30.01.2022 17:16</h5>
                            </div>
                            <p class="comment-text">Всем доброго времени суток! Не знаю как остальные, а я выскажу своё субъективное мнение по поводу артеллерии. Сразу скажу, я считаю, что её нужно апать. Вот вы сами подумайте, нормальный ТТ-10 наносит за 10 секунд 500 урона, а арта за 20 секунд только даст такой урон. Видите, урона меньше, значит, нужно подгонять её под урон ТТ-9 хотя бы. Тогда будет честно, это говорю вам я - Жак Вспышко!</p>
                            <div class="buttons-comment-block">
                                <div class="answer-container">
                                    <button class="buttons-comment add-answer">
                                        <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
                                            <g opacity="0.4">
                                            <mask id="mask0_3_259" style="mask-type:alpha" maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x="0" y="0" width="22" height="22">
                                            <rect width="22" height="22" fill="url(#pattern0_3_259)"/>
                                            </mask>
                                            <g mask="url(#mask0_3_259)">
                                            <rect x="-2" y="-1" width="26" height="25" fill="black"/>
                                            </g>
                                            </g>
                                            <defs>
                                            <pattern id="pattern0_3_259" patternContentUnits="objectBoundingBox" width="1" height="1">
                                            <use xlink:href="#image0_3_259" transform="scale(0.01)"/>
                                            </pattern>
                                            <image id="image0_3_259" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="none" xlink:href="data:image/png;base64,"/>
                                            </defs>
                                        </svg>
                                        Ответить
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div class="favorites-container">
                                    <button class="buttons-comment add-favorites">
                                        <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
                                            <mask id="mask0_3_291" style="mask-type:alpha" maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x="0" y="0" width="24" height="24">
                                            <rect width="24" height="24" fill="url(#pattern0_3_291)"/>
                                            </mask>
                                            <g mask="url(#mask0_3_291)">
                                            <rect opacity="0.4" x="2" y="4" width="21" height="19" fill="black"/>
                                            <path d="M3.5 9.00004C2.5 12.9999 8.83333 17.3333 12 20C20 14.4 21.1667 10.5001 20.5 9.00004C18.5 4.20004 13.8333 6.16667 12 8.00001C7 3.5 4.5 6.50002 3.5 9.00004Z" fill="white"/>
                                            </g>
                                            <defs>
                                            <pattern id="pattern0_3_291" patternContentUnits="objectBoundingBox" width="1" height="1">
                                            <use xlink:href="#image0_3_291" transform="scale(0.0104167)"/>
                                            </pattern>
                                            <image id="image0_3_291" width="96" height="96" preserveAspectRatio="none" xlink:href="data:image/png;base64,"/>
                                            </defs>
                                        </svg>
                                        В избранное
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div class="rating-comment-container">
                                    <button class="buttons-comment rating-button demotion" data-action="down">
                                        <svg width="20" height="23" viewBox="0 0 20 23" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                            <circle opacity="0.1" cx="10" cy="13" r="10" fill="black"/>
                                            <path d="M13.0696 11.6399V13.2955H7.26562V11.6399H13.0696Z" fill="#FF0000"/>
                                        </svg>
                                    </button>
                                    <p class="rating-count">0</p>
                                    <button class="buttons-comment rating-button increase" data-action="up">
                                        <svg width="20" height="23" viewBox="0 0 20 23" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                            <circle opacity="0.1" cx="10" cy="13" r="10" fill="black"/>
                                            <path d="M9.13281 17.169V8.52699H10.8523V17.169H9.13281ZM5.67472 13.7045V11.9851H14.3168V13.7045H5.67472Z" fill="#8AC540"/>
                                        </svg>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="comment-block lvl-2-nesting" data-comment-id="002">
                        <img class="avatar" src="../images/Near_You.png" width="61" height="61">
                        <div class="input-container">
                            <div class="comment-information-container">
                                <h3 class="name-commentator">Алексей Кучкин</h3>
                                <div class="name-answer">
                                    <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
                                        <g opacity="0.4">
                                        <mask id="mask0_3_259" style="mask-type:alpha" maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x="0" y="0" width="22" height="22">
                                        <rect width="22" height="22" fill="url(#pattern0_3_259)"/>
                                        </mask>
                                        <g mask="url(#mask0_3_259)">
                                        <rect x="-2" y="-1" width="26" height="25" fill="black"/>
                                        </g>
                                        </g>
                                        <defs>
                                        <pattern id="pattern0_3_259" patternContentUnits="objectBoundingBox" width="1" height="1">
                                        <use xlink:href="#image0_3_259" transform="scale(0.01)"/>
                                        </pattern>
                                        <image id="image0_3_259" width="100" height="100" preserveAspectRatio="none" xlink:href="data:image/png;base64,"/>
                                        </defs>
                                    </svg>
                                    <h3 class="buttons-comment answer">Сергей Карапитек</h3>
                                </div>
                                <h5 class="comment-date-time">30.01.2022 17:54</h5>
                            </div>
                            <p class="comment-text">Дядь Серёж, ты бы таблеточки от шизофрении выпил что ли... Может ещё стан вернуть и крит внутренним модулям повысить? Тогда и Петрович не нужен будет с Instress</p>
                            <div class="buttons-comment-block">
                                <div class="favorites-container">
                                    <button class="buttons-comment add-favorites">
                                        <svg width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 22 22" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
                                            <mask id="mask0_3_291" style="mask-type:alpha" maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x="0" y="0" width="24" height="24">
                                            <rect width="24" height="24" fill="url(#pattern0_3_291)"/>
                                            </mask>
                                            <g mask="url(#mask0_3_291)">
                                            <rect opacity="0.4" x="2" y="4" width="21" height="19" fill="black"/>
                                            <path d="M3.5 9.00004C2.5 12.9999 8.83333 17.3333 12 20C20 14.4 21.1667 10.5001 20.5 9.00004C18.5 4.20004 13.8333 6.16667 12 8.00001C7 3.5 4.5 6.50002 3.5 9.00004Z" fill="white"/>
                                            </g>
                                            <defs>
                                            <pattern id="pattern0_3_291" patternContentUnits="objectBoundingBox" width="1" height="1">
                                            <use xlink:href="#image0_3_291" transform="scale(0.0104167)"/>
                                            </pattern>
                                            <image id="image0_3_291" width="96" height="96" preserveAspectRatio="none" xlink:href="data:image/png;base64,"/>
                                            </defs>
                                        </svg>
                                        В избранное
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                                <div class="rating-comment-container">
                                    <button class="buttons-comment rating-button demotion" data-action="down">
                                        <svg width="20" height="23" viewBox="0 0 20 23" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                            <circle opacity="0.1" cx="10" cy="13" r="10" fill="black"/>
                                            <path d="M13.0696 11.6399V13.2955H7.26562V11.6399H13.0696Z" fill="#FF0000"/>
                                        </svg>
                                    </button>
                                    <p class="rating-count">0</p>
                                    <button class="buttons-comment rating-button increase" data-action="up">
                                        <svg width="20" height="23" viewBox="0 0 20 23" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
                                            <circle opacity="0.1" cx="10" cy="13" r="10" fill="black"/>
                                            <path d="M9.13281 17.169V8.52699H10.8523V17.169H9.13281ZM5.67472 13.7045V11.9851H14.3168V13.7045H5.67472Z" fill="#8AC540"/>
                                        </svg>
                                    </button>
                                </div>
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    </div>
                </div>
                
            </div>
        </main>
    </div>
    
    <footer class="footer">

    </footer>
</body>
</html>
